captions.detailed: A cinema zoom lens featuring a dark alloy barrel with three distinct ribbed control rings: a front focus ring, a middle zoom ring, and a rear iris aperture ring. A semi-transparent blue-tinted glass element is visible at the front, and a light gray metallic PL mount is attached to the rear. The focus, zoom, and iris rings are designed to rotate independently on revolute joints, while the inner barrel extends or retracts along a prismatic joint when zooming.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cinema zoom lens with a dark alloy barrel, three ribbed control rings (focus, zoom, and iris), a front glass element, and a light-gray PL mount. The rings should be configured with revolute joints for rotation, and the inner barrel should have a prismatic joint to simulate zoom extension.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using concentric cylinders representing the outer sleeve, inner barrel, and front lens element. Model the control rings (focus, zoom, and iris) by creating cylindrical bases and patterning small rectangular prisms or fins radially to form the ribbed gear teeth. Assemble the components using an articulated model structure, defining revolute joints for the rotating rings and a prismatic joint for the sliding inner barrel.
